I am Roberta Cunha, a growth marketing freelancer based in Amsterdam. I combine audience research, behavioural psychology and hands-on execution.

More about me

FAQ

Questions I get on every call

Who will do the work?

I do, from strategy to execution. Every strategy, ad and report is mine, and nothing is outsourced. I use AI for speed in research and analysis, never in place of judgement.

What kind of companies do you work with?

I work with B2B companies, B2C brands and subscription apps, from scale-ups to medium-sized businesses, across the Netherlands and Europe.

Where do we start?

With a growth audit of your channels, tracking, customer data and margins. Every plan starts from what the audit finds holding growth back, ranked by what to fix first.

Can I hire you for one part only?

Yes. You can hire me for the full package or for a single service, such as a growth audit, paid ads or lifecycle flows. For larger teams, we agree on the scope after the audit, and I work alongside your in-house team.

Which platforms do you work in?

Most of my work runs on LinkedIn, Meta, Google and Microsoft Ads. I have also run TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads and programmatic campaigns in DV360, and I recommend the channel mix based on your product or service and your target audience. For CRM, most of my experience is in HubSpot, and I build flows in the CRM your team runs today.

How do you report results?

I build my reports in Python, which gives you one consistent view across all your channels. You get a short weekly report, a full monthly review against your targets, and a quarterly budget reallocation.

What does it cost?

Every proposal is scoped to your goals and the work needed. After our call, you receive a proposal with the scope, timeline and price.

Which languages do you work in?

English, Portuguese and Spanish, with conversational Dutch.

Start with a free 30 minute call

In 30 minutes we go through your goals, your current setup and what you need. After the call, you receive a proposal with the scope and the next steps. Based in Amsterdam, working with clients across Europe.
